h:
此工作流程旨在与冈萨洛莫通量模型生成图像，然后使用GonzaLomo v4.0 UnitySDXL 型号。 Unity 将为图像提供更好的皮肤细节和解剖特征。

请注意，不需要使用 GonzaLomo SDXL 模型，因为任何逼真的 SDXL 模型都应该在细化 Flux 图像方面做得非常好。

另一件需要注意的事情是通过 Conditioning Concat 节点与原始提示合并的精炼提示。您可以在此提示中放入您想要在最终图像中强调的任何内容。我添加了诸如“皮肤毛孔和瑕疵”之类的内容，以使皮肤具有较少的塑性通量外观。您还可以添加雀斑。该提示的效果大小由降噪决定。如果您只想进行轻微细化，请将噪点保持在 0.1 到 0.2 之间。高于 0.2 可以让 SDXL 模型充分细化图像。我自己喜欢 0.35，但我认为这是个人喜好。

o.en:
This workflow is intended to be used with theGonzaLomo Fluxmodel to generate an image and then refine the image using theGonzaLomo v4.0 UnitySDXL model. Unity will provide the image with much better skin detail and anatomical features.

Note that it's not required to use the GonzaLomo SDXL model as any photorealistic SDXL model should do a very good job at refining the Flux image.

One other thing to note is the refining prompt that is being merged with the original prompt via the Conditioning Concat node. You can put anything into this prompt that you'd like to emphasize in the final image. I included things like "skin pores and blemishes" to give the skin a less plastic Flux look. You could also add freckles. The amount of effect that this prompt has is governed by the denoise. If you want only a light refining then keep the denoise between 0.1 and 0.2. Go higher than 0.2 to allow the SDXL model to fully refine the image. I like 0.35 myself but I think that's a personal preference.
